cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Say You Saw It Too
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you send this soup back, did you notice anything moving?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm complaining about cold noodles. What did you see?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Tell me whether one waved. I need your word before I explain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It waved me closer. I'm still not eating it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll understand why I've ordered it lunch. Could you ask whether it wants your bread?

mechanism: A holds up the soup complaint and requires B's impossible observation before revealing A's own more committed response.
confusable: Unlike only anthropomorphizing noodles, A waits for corroboration before admitting feeding one.
comparison: A restaurant complaint becomes feeding an observed noodle, unlike holding a door for a shadow.
seedUse: The seed already orders B's report before explaining and then recruits the next action, giving S01 control of the exchange.
